x: John Thresher was not at his best following an injury, and injury kept John Davis out of the team. Joe Dooley and Don MacLean completed our runners.
The indefatigable Paul Pringle was our next man home, a minute or so ahead of John Davis, of 1:52.8 880yds/4:10.6 mile fame some 17 years ago and here making his debut at the marathon.

PAM and JOHN DAVIS, another Selsonia Ladies AC/Belgrave partnership, are also doing their best to keep the Club stocked with thoroughbreds, and seven weeks after the arrival of another bouncing boy, Pam was out jogging again.
